name: s95-session-start-clears-pre-v2-summary

setup_files.CODEBASE_MAP.md:
# CODEBASE_MAP
Present so session-start has something to point at.

notes: TAN-6278 review finding 2. A project upgrading from a pre-v2 kit has only last_quality_gate.json, written without a session_id. summary_line resolves it to "-", treats it as this session's, and a brand-new session's first stop — with no edits at all — exited 2. The summary is derived, not the record of truth, so session-start now clears it when it carries no session_id; a summary that names a session (s22) is still kept, and the v2 state is never touched.
